span.p:
Workspace facade
[app.services]
one API for UI and CLIs: ingest,
evidence, generate, review, export,
report runs, evaluation

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ingestion
[ingestion]
parsers per template, checksums,
dedup, theme tagging → SourceRecords

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Image analysis
[imaging]
maps measured in code; infographics read
by a vision model, confirmed by a researcher

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence builder
[evidence]
computes counts, shares, averages,
comparisons → Evidence with ids

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drafting pipelines
[drafting]
template · naive · staged · single-call;
versioned prompts; claims cite ids

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Model layer
[llm]
providers, registry, privacy guard,
memory monitor

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Verifier
[verification]
flags per claim: grounded / weak /
unsupported; never rewrites

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Review log
[review]
approve / edit / reject; append-only,
hash-chained events

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Export
[export]
gate; Word report in house style;
charts from evidence; evidence map

div.style: color: rgb(11, 35, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Report runs and evaluation

the original; local judge; κ

citation metrics on synthetic gold
claims (TC5–TC8)
